prior_sources.title: TensorRT-LLM AutoDeploy FuseGemms
prior_sources.read_depth: Read _insert_fused_gemm and FuseGemms/FuseGemmsMixedChildren; full source snapshot retained.
prior_sources.evidence: Shared-input linear weights are concatenated along output rows; one linear call computes the outputs, then torch.narrow separates them. Bias/dtype compatibility is checked.
prior_sources.novelty_implication: Ordinary same-input vertical concatenation and output demultiplexing are established compiler operations; NAND legality/cost is a separate systems question.

prior_sources.title: MoE as Dense GEMM: Optimizing Low-Latency MoE Inference on NVIDIA Blackwell
prior_sources.read_depth: Read design, kernel table, scope and limitations. Publication date not separately verified; versioned page fetched at audit time.
prior_sources.evidence: FC1 concatenates experts along output N and computes all routed experts; inactive arithmetic is explicitly charged. Shared experts remain separate in the current implementation. The batch1 case loses to grouped GEMM.
prior_sources.transfer_limit: GPU FP4 dense kernels/alpha fusion do not establish existing AiF operations or numerics. Only the same-input FC1 concatenation principle transfers.

prior_sources.title: Neuralink: Fast LLM Inference on Smartphones with Neuron Co-Activation Linking
prior_sources.read_depth: Sections4/5 read, especially5.1; earlier project audit separately covers metadata.
prior_sources.evidence: Coactivation-based path ordering plus online access collapse reads intervening neurons to merge nearby logical reads. It trades bytes against IOPS and disables collapse when bandwidth-bound.
prior_sources.transfer_limit: UFS retrieval/cache method; no native IFP matrix row-reset/plane-address contract. The coactivation path heuristic here is a generic prior control, not a new algorithm.

prior_sources.title: SLIM: A Heterogeneous Accelerator for Edge Inference of Sparse Large Language Model via Adaptive Thresholding
prior_sources.evidence: Packs consecutive fused neuron vectors into pages and distributes aligned vectors across dies; discussion suggests same-wordline multipane placement.
prior_sources.transfer_limit: Its fused gate/up/down sparse FFN datapath and SRAM are architecture changes relative to AiF; not added here.

prior_sources.title: AiF: Accelerating On-Device LLM Inference Using In-Flash Processing
prior_sources.read_depth: Section4.4/Figure14,printed536–537, rechecked from local supplied paper.
prior_sources.evidence: Command supplies input dimension, block ID/offset/pagecount; sequential matrix stream, INT8 PEs, FIFO/SREG results. Matrix-boundary skip/reset within one command and arbitrary plane starts are not disclosed.
prior_sources.transfer_limit: Row concatenation is algebraically ordinary GEMV if every row is a complete same-C vector and the command begins at column0. Full valid-R/output/scaling/fringe semantics remain unverified.

legality.existing_addresses: Sealed per-matrix jobs reserve whole waves. Their padding bytes need not be a multiple of C, so adjacent physical job reservations are not automatically one legal dense row stream.
required_static_lowering: Repack actual full rows into one C-wide stream with an explicit expert/logical-row map.
Start each conservative command at row128 multiple and matching5WL offset; split at physical blocks.
Read/compute/return every intervening inactive or padding row, including prefixes required for legal starts.
Retain one chip context through the merged stream's channel drain. Down gets its own private input and is not merged.
Do not credit per-expert GU host-submit savings: current baseline already has one2us GU submission and one common320ns upload.
incomplete_ABI: Whether row results can release an expert before the merged command drains
legality.address_relaxation_erratum: The32row screen additionally ignores starting plane/page's intra-WL offset in wave counts. Thus it is an ideal sliding-window relaxation, not an executable ordinary-multiplane result. Strict128row cases do not have this issue.

earlier_experiments.static_bundles: Old static bundle B2/B4 reads the entire bundle whenever any member is selected; differs from optional prefix/gap range coalescing.
earlier_experiments.selected_WL_union: Earlier G4/Deep screen gave favorable read-only bounds0.1284%/0.3881% of routedFFN and found G4 C1536 row-phase trouble. Does not certify the later Qwen38 workload.
earlier_experiments.horizontal_down_bundles: Earlier downhorizontalconcat changes the operation to a weighted output sum; unrelated to ordinary same-input GU vertical row concatenation. Down remains separate here.

layouts: dense fullrow stream with required prefix
current_screen.objective: Exact per-chip additive native GU context work under all-ready relaxation; not full resource-DAG scheduling or measured latency.
current_screen.result: For strict128row alignment, best among tested layouts/orders is unmerged singleton work in every family/layer. Dense packing increases work. Even the extra-favorable32row relaxation does not beat existing whole-row GU.
current_screen.novelty_decision: Retain GU coalescing as a mandatory generic compiler control; no new fusion algorithm or positive system result established. Fixed-row bound and three orderings do not exclude all joint reshards/cluster layouts.

whole_row_certificate.scope: Fixed whole-row geometry only, for any subset of at most11 objects on one chip, even perfect query-adaptive adjacency/no gaps. It is not a general placement or scheduler impossibility theorem.
whole_row_certificate.residual_cost_opportunity: At most10*(250+1280)=15300ns native command/input work per chip; channel-input demand at most25600ns less per channel; aggregate controller work at most40000ns less (176 to16 commands). These overlapping resource budgets are not additive or guaranteed FFN latency savings.
